params.description: If set to `true`, the operation will continue for the valid items even if some items result in failure.

params.description: If set to `true`, returns information about the newly created entity.

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs:
Adds multiple files to the current user's mobile sync list in a single request. Supports partial success, meaning valid items are processed even if some fail. This operation will not return location headers for each entity created, if the inserted records are
        required, returnEntity should be set to true.

info.name: List mobile sync items for the current user

params.name: returnEntity
params.description: If true, includes the entity in the response body.

params.name: with
params.description: Specifies additional fields to include in the response.

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

params.name: avStatus
params.description: Filter results by antivirus scan status. Accepted values: `allowed`, `disallowed`, `scanning`.

params.name: dlpStatus
params.description: Filter results by DLP scan status. Accepted values: `allowed`, `disallowed`, `scanning`.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
Sort order for the results. Default is `created:desc`.
Allowed values: `created:asc`, `created:desc`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Range limit.

params.name: offset
params.description: Range offset.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Returns a paginated list of mobile sync items belonging to the current user.
### Precondition:
  User must be authenticated. The tenant must not be suspended and the license must not be expired.
### Response:
  Returns a list of mobile sync items for the current user.

### Description:
  Returns information about the specified mobile sync item belonging to the current user.

  User must be authenticated and must own the specified mobile sync item. The tenant must not be suspended and the license must not be expired.
### Response:
